extractor_note: CRS is a specialty-alloy producer with 62% of FY2025 sales to 'Aerospace and Defense' end-use market. The 10-K does NOT name any specific Pentagon Program Element (PE) numbers, named program-of-record titles (e.g., F-35, B-21, CCA, NGAD, Sentinel, Columbia), DoD prime customers, IDIQ ceilings, or contract numbers. Defense exposure is described only at the end-market aggregate level. This is itself a J-Book-divergence-relevant data point: forward-looking narrative leans on aggregate A&D market growth without naming any specific PE/program the framework could verify in pentagon_jbook. Claims below capture the strongest J-Book-grounded language the filing offers (which is generic) plus standard control claims (facilities, patents, counterparty disclosure).
